basis: ONCV pseudopotentials and TZDP 9-au numerical atomic orbitals from ABACUS-orbitals/TZDP_9au
notes: One P42/nmc structure and one electronic setup are used for force constants, BEC contraction, and Raman tensors.
The largest acoustic residual is 0.357 cm-1 and no substantive imaginary mode is present.
All 15 optical modes are retained; the analytic Gamma calculation reports the TO manifold without a non-analytic LO-TO correction.
The strongest Raman line is A1g at 286.16 cm-1; the largest normalized residual among Eu, A2u, and B2u modes is 5.86e-9.
Raw ABACUS, matrix, and cube outputs are intentionally excluded from the compact publication archive.
